race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
race.verdict: OUR PLANET has found things tough so far this season, but he shaped better than the result at this course on his latest outing and could well revive for a switch of stables. From his much reduced mark, he gets the vote ahead of Barry The Worm who isn't taken lightly at this venue, with Love Alive also considered. OUR PLANET (IRE) BARRY THE WORM LOVE ALIVE
